content: For Electron apps needing cross-process reactive state (main process as source of truth broadcasting to renderer stores), community patterns wrap Zustand with an IPC bridge (zutron, @zubridge/electron): one Zustand store in main (source of truth), one mirrored in renderer, actions dispatched renderer->main, state diffs pushed main->renderer, with batching/delta updates to reduce IPC overhead for high-frequency changes.
